strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Porogaramu y'abacuruzi bazenguruka na van sales
strings.tierB.home.description: Ku bakwirakwiza: inyemezabuguzi n'inyemezabwishyu kuri telefoni, ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka, kwishyuza, inzira n'ingendo. Ikora nta murandasi.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Yobora abacuruzi bawe bazenguruka kuva ku ruzinduko rwa mbere kugeza ku mafaranga ya nyuma yishyujwe
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ni urubuga rwo kuri cloud rugenewe ibigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa n'abaranguza bifite abacuruzi bazenguruka (sales reps). Abacuruzi batanga kandi bagacapa inyemezabuguzi n'inyemezabwishyu bakoresheje telefoni, bagakurikirana ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka kandi bakandika ingendo bakoze, mu gihe abayobozi babona ako kanya ibyagurishijwe, amafaranga yishyujwe n'amadeni y'abakiriya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Inyemezabuguzi kuri telefoni y'umucuruzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Umucuruzi atanga inyemezabuguzi ari ku muryango w'umukiriya, akayicapa kuri printer ya Bluetooth ikoresha ubushyuhe (thermal) mbere yo kuva mu iduka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kwishyuza n'amadeni y'abakiriya
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Buri bwishyu buhabwa inyemezabwishyu ifite nimero, ihujwe n'inyemezabuguzi bwishyura, kandi umwenda w'umukiriya na raporo ya konti ye bihita bihinduka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Inshingano ku bicuruzwa biri mu modoka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Ibicuruzwa bya buri modoka bikurikiranwa kimwe kimwe: ibyapakiwe, ibyagurishijwe, ibyagaruwe n'ibisigaye, ku buryo icyuho kigaragara uwo munsi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Inzira n'ingendo ku bakiriya
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Buri ruzinduko rwandikwa n'aho rwabereye, isaha n'amafoto, kandi inzira ya buri mucuruzi igaragazwa ku ikarita ku muyobozi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ikora nta murandasi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abacuruzi bakomeza gucuruza nta rezo. Inyandiko zibikwa muri telefoni zikoherezwa zonyine, nta kwisubiramo, iyo murandasi igarutse.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Urubuga rw'igenzura ku bayobozi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ibyagurishijwe, ibyishyujwe, ibyagaruwe, ububiko n'umusaruro w'abacuruzi ahantu hamwe, hamwe n'inshingano n'uburenganzira kuri buri mukoresha.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tubwire uko mucuruza
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Saba proforma cyangwa uteganye inama. Turebera hamwe abacuruzi banyu, inzira, ibicuruzwa n'ibyo mukenera ku nyemezabuguzi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Tegura ikigo cyawe
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Injiza ibicuruzwa, ibiciro byabyo, abakiriya n'abacuruzi, kandi ushyire mu igenamiterere ifaranga n'igipimo cy'umusoro by'igihugu cyawe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Ohereza abacuruzi mu kazi
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abacuruzi bashyira porogaramu kuri Android cyangwa iPhone, bagapakira imodoka bagatangira gucuruza, gucapa no kwishyuza.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Kurikirana umunsi uko ugenda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Urubuga rw'igenzura rugaragaza ibyagurishijwe, ibyishyujwe, ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka n'ingendo mu gihe abacuruzi bakiri mu nzira.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ni urubuga rwo kuri cloud rwo kuyobora abacuruzi bazenguruka mu bigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa n'abaranguza. Rukubiyemo van sales (gucururiza mu modoka), route sales (gucuruza ku nzira zizwi), pre-sales (gufata komande mbere) na DSD (kugeza ibicuruzwa ku iduka mu buryo butaziguye). Abacuruzi batanga inyemezabuguzi, bagacapa, bakishyuza kandi bakandika ingendo bakoresheje telefoni, naho abayobozi bagakurikirana ibyagurishijwe, ibyishyujwe, ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka n'amadeni y'abakiriya ku rubuga rw'igenzura.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yego. Porogaramu y'umucuruzi ikomeza gukora nta murandasi: umucuruzi atanga kandi agacapa inyemezabuguzi n'inyemezabwishyu, akandika ingendo kandi akongeramo abakiriya, maze byose bikoherezwa byonyine nta kwisubiramo iyo murandasi igarutse. Hariho ikintu kimwe kidasanzwe muri Arabiya Sawudite: ibigo byafunguye kwihuza n'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga bikenera murandasi igihe inyemezabuguzi cyangwa iy'ibicuruzwa byagaruwe itangwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales ikorera ibigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa mu bihugu byose. Buri kigo gishyira ifaranga ryacyo n'igipimo cy'umusoro mu igenamiterere ryacyo, kandi inyemezabuguzi, inyemezabwishyu na raporo birabikoresha. Icyicaro cya FieldSales kiri i Riyadh muri Arabiya Sawudite, kandi gutangira bikorwa kuri murandasi binyuze mu nama, WhatsApp n'ubufasha bwa kure.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales ihuzwa na sisitemu za Leta z'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Dushyigikiye kwihuza n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA ku cyiciro cya kabiri. Ibi bireba ibigo biri muri Arabiya Sawudite. Mu bindi bihugu, harimo n'u Rwanda, FieldSales itanga inyemezabuguzi zifite ifaranga ryawe n'igipimo cy'umusoro wawe, kandi kwihuza na sisitemu y'igihugu y'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga biboneka ubisabye, nyuma yo gusuzumana nawe ibisabwa n'icyo gihugu. Hanze ya Arabiya Sawudite ntidusezeranya ko inyemezabuguzi zizahuza n'ibisabwa n'igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Porogaramu ya FieldSales iboneka mu zihe ndimi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Imigaragarire ya porogaramu ya FieldSales (interface) iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira gusa: Icyarabu, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kinyarwanda. Abacuruzi n'abayobozi bashobora guhindura ururimi rw'imigaragarire, kandi inyemezabuguzi zicapwa zishobora kugira ururimi rwa kabiri iruhande rw'urw'ibanze. Paji z'urubuga mu zindi ndimi, harimo n'iyi paji y'Ikinyarwanda, ni ubuhinduzi bugamije gutanga amakuru ku bijyanye na FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Saba proforma, uteganye inama cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp. Twiga uko abacuruzi bawe bakora, hanyuma tukagufasha kwinjiza ibicuruzwa, ibiciro byabyo, abakiriya n'abacuruzi. Abacuruzi bashyira porogaramu kuri Android cyangwa iPhone, naho abayobozi bagakoresha urubuga rw'igenzura muri mushakisha iyo ari yo yose. Telefoni zigezweho (smartphone) ni zo bikoresho byonyine ukeneye.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Imigaragarire ya porogaramu ya FieldSales iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira: Icyarabu, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kinyarwanda. Paji ziri mu zindi ndimi zisobanura FieldSales mu rwego rwo gutanga amakuru gusa.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van sales: porogaramu yo gucururiza mu modoka | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Porogaramu ya van sales na route sales: inyemezabuguzi zicapwa zivuye kuri telefoni, ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka, kwishyuza n'ingendo. Ikora nta murandasi.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Porogaramu ya van sales (gucururiza mu modoka) ku bakwirakwiza ibicuruzwa n'abaranguza
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ni porogaramu ya van sales igenewe ibigo bifite abacuruzi bacururiza mu modoka ku nzira za buri munsi. Umucuruzi apakira imodoka, agacuruza kuri buri iduka, agacapa inyemezabuguzi, akishyuza kandi akandika ibicuruzwa byagaruwe akoresheje porogaramu imwe kuri telefoni. Umuyobozi abona ibyapakiwe, ibyagurishijwe, ibyishyujwe n'ibisigaye muri buri modoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Porogaramu ya van sales ni iki?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Porogaramu ya van sales, yitwa kandi cash van cyangwa route sales, icunga uburyo bwo gucuruza aho umucuruzi atwara ibicuruzwa mu modoka akagurisha, akabigeza, agatanga inyemezabuguzi kandi akishyuza mu ruzinduko rumwe. Isimbura ibitabo by'inyemezabuguzi by'impapuro n'amaterefone yo ku mugoroba. Yandika buri igurisha, buri bwishyu na buri gicuruzwa cyagaruwe nk'inyandiko, ku buryo ububiko n'amafaranga bigenzurwa uwo munsi. Ku muyobozi, isubiza ibibazo bitatu buri mugoroba: buri mucuruzi yagurishije iki, yishyuje angahe, kandi ni iki gisigaye muri buri modoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Umunsi umwe mu kazi ko hanze
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Umunsi utangirana no gupakira imodoka ibicuruzwa bivuye mu bubiko, byose byanditswe. Kuri buri iduka, umucuruzi ahitamo umukiriya muri porogaramu, akongeramo ibicuruzwa akoresheje urutonde cyangwa barcode, agatanga inyemezabuguzi akayicapa kuri printer ikoresha ubushyuhe. Ubwishyu bwandikwa n'inyemezabwishyu, kandi igicuruzwa cyose cyagaruwe cyandikwa n'impamvu yacyo. Ku mugoroba, ibisigaye mu modoka bisubizwa mu bubiko. Hagati y'izo ntambwe, umuyobozi ashobora gukurikirana ibyagurishijwe, ibyishyujwe n'ingendo bya buri mucuruzi ku rubuga rw'igenzura atarinze guhamagara umuntu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yubakiwe ahantu hari rezo nke
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Inzira zo gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa zinyura mu nsi y'inyubako, mu bice by'inganda no mu byaro bifite rezo nke. Porogaramu y'umucuruzi ya FieldSales ibika abakiriya, ibicuruzwa n'ibiciro byabyo kuri telefoni, ku buryo umucuruzi ashobora gutanga no gucapa inyandiko nta murandasi. Buri nyandiko ifite urufunguzo rwihariye, bityo igera kuri seriveri rimwe gusa, n'iyo kohereza byasubirwamo. Ibigo byo muri Arabiya Sawudite byafunguye kwihuza n'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga bikenera murandasi igihe inyemezabuguzi n'iz'ibicuruzwa byagaruwe zitangwa. Inyemezabwishyu, ingendo n'abakiriya bashya byo bikomeza gukora nta murandasi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kwishyuza n'inshingano ku modoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Amafaranga atwarwa mu nzira akeneye igenzura nk'iry'ibicuruzwa. Buri bwishyu buhabwa inyemezabwishyu ifite nimero ishobora guhuzwa n'inyemezabuguzi bwishyura, kandi umwenda w'umukiriya uhita uhinduka. Ibicuruzwa biri mu modoka bibarwa kuri buri gicuruzwa: ibyapakiwe ukuyemo ibyagurishijwe, wongeyeho ibyagaruwe n'ihinduka ryanditswe, ku buryo abayobozi babigereranya n'ibarura nyaryo mbere y'uko umucuruzi ataha. Ibyagaruwe bishobora gushyirwa mu byiciro: bisanzwe, byangiritse cyangwa ibyo guhinduranya, kandi umuyobozi ni we wemeza niba bisubira mu bicuruzwa bigurishwa biri mu modoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Igenewe nde?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ikwiriye abakwirakwiza n'abaranguza b'ibicuruzwa bigurishwa vuba nk'ibiribwa, ibinyobwa, ibikoresho by'isuku n'iby'isuku y'umubiri, n'ikigo icyo ari cyo cyose gifite abacuruzi basura amaduka ku nzira. Ishyigikira van sales, komande za pre-sales na DSD (kugeza ibicuruzwa ku iduka mu buryo butaziguye). Si ERP yuzuye: ihuzwa na sisitemu yawe y'ibaruramari cyangwa ERP binyuze kuri API. Abayobozi bagena icyo buri mucuruzi yemerewe gukora, nko gutanga igabanyirizwa, kugurisha munsi y'igiciro cyo ku rutonde cyangwa kongeramo abakiriya bashya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Ni irihe tandukaniro hagati ya van sales na pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Muri van sales, umucuruzi atwara ibicuruzwa akabigeza, agatanga inyemezabuguzi kandi akishyuza mu ruzinduko rumwe. Muri pre-sales, umucuruzi afata komande, ububiko bukazayigeza nyuma. FieldSales ishyigikira ubwo buryo bwombi, ku buryo ikigo gishobora gukoresha cash van ku nzira zimwe no gufata komande ku zindi. Muri ubwo buryo bwombi, inyemezabuguzi, ibyishyujwe n'amadeni y'abakiriya biba muri sisitemu imwe, kandi abayobozi babibona muri raporo zimwe.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Nahuza nte konti y'imodoka ku mugoroba?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales igaragaza, kuri buri gicuruzwa muri buri modoka, ingano yapakiwe, yagurishijwe, yagaruwe n'isigaye. Gereranya ingano isigaye n'ibarura nyaryo, wandike itandukaniro nk'ihinduka ryanditswe, hanyuma usubize ibisigaye mu bubiko mu gikorwa kimwe. Imodoka itangira umunsi ukurikiyeho ifite konti isukuye kandi izwi.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Umucuruzi wa van sales akenera ibihe bikoresho?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Telefoni igezweho (smartphone), Android cyangwa iPhone. Printer ya Bluetooth ikoresha ubushyuhe si itegeko, ariko ifasha umucuruzi guha umukiriya inyemezabuguzi cyangwa inyemezabwishyu icapye. FieldSales ntigurisha ibikoresho kandi ntisaba ubwoko runaka bwa printer. Abayobozi bakoresha urubuga rw'igenzura muri mushakisha ya mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni iyo ari yo yose.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales ishobora guhuzwa na sisitemu yacu y'ibaruramari?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yego. FieldSales itanga API ituma sisitemu yawe y'ibaruramari cyangwa ERP ihererekanya n'urubuga abakiriya, ibicuruzwa, inyemezabuguzi, inyemezabwishyu n'iyimurwa ry'ububiko. Itsinda ryawe cyangwa uwo mukorana mu guhuza sisitemu yubaka iryo huriro akoresheje inyandiko zisobanura API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu bihugu: ifaranga, umusoro, e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales ikorera abakwirakwiza mu bihugu byose. Reba mu mbonerahamwe imwe ifaranga, umusoro n'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga bya buri gihugu.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales ikorera ibigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa mu bihugu byose. Buri kigo gihitamo igihugu cyacyo, ifaranga n'igipimo cy'umusoro mu igenamiterere ryacyo, kandi inyemezabuguzi, inyemezabwishyu na raporo bikurikiza ibyo. Kwihuza na sisitemu ya Leta y'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga birakora muri Arabiya Sawudite gusa. Mu bindi bihugu byose biboneka ubisabye. Imbonerahamwe ikurikira igaragaza, kuri buri gihugu, ifaranga rihakoreshwa, igipimo gisanzwe cy'umusoro ku igurisha cyangwa TVA, n'uko kwihuza na sisitemu ya Leta y'inyemezabuguzi z'ikoranabuhanga bihagaze: birakora cyangwa biboneka ubisabye.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Dushyigikiye kwihuza n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA ku cyiciro cya kabiri
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ifaranga n'igipimo cy'umusoro bishyirwaho na buri kigo mu igenamiterere ryacyo. Ibipimo biri muri iyi mbonerahamwe ni ubuyobozi rusange kandi bishobora guhinduka; banza wemeze amategeko agezweho n'umujyanama wawe mu by'imisoro. Akarongo (—) gasobanura ko nta gipimo rusange cyanditswe kuri icyo gihugu.
strings.tierB.about.title: Ibyerekeye FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales ikora porogaramu zo kuri cloud ku bigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa bifite abacuruzi bazenguruka. Yashinzwe mu 2026 i Riyadh, Arabiya Sawudite.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (izina mu Cyarabu: فيلد سيلز) ni urubuga rwo kuri cloud rugenewe ibigo bikwirakwiza ibicuruzwa n'abaranguza bifite abacuruzi bazenguruka. Ikigo cyashinzwe mu 2026 kandi gifite icyicaro i Riyadh muri Arabiya Sawudite. Gikorera ibigo byo mu bihugu byose, kandi ifaranga n'igipimo cy'umusoro bya buri gihugu bishyirwa mu igenamiterere ry'ikigo ubwacyo. Abakiriya bacu ni ibigo bigurisha kandi bikageza ibicuruzwa binyuze ku bacuruzi bari mu nzira: abakwirakwiza, abaranguza n'inganda zifite imodoka zazo zo gucuruza.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Twubaka sisitemu imwe ihuriweho ku rugendo rwose rw'akazi ko hanze: inyemezabuguzi zicapwa zivuye kuri telefoni y'umucuruzi, inyemezabwishyu n'amadeni y'abakiriya, inshingano ku bicuruzwa biri mu modoka, inzira n'ingendo bifite aho byabereye n'amafoto, n'urubuga rw'igenzura ku bayobozi. Porogaramu y'umucuruzi ikora kuri Android na iPhone kandi ikomeza gukora nta murandasi, hanyuma igahuza amakuru iyo murandasi igarutse. Ibigo bishobora guhuza FieldSales na sisitemu yabyo y'ibaruramari cyangwa ERP binyuze kuri API, ku buryo amakuru yo hanze adakenera kwandikwa kabiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Dusobanura porogaramu uko iri. Dushyigikiye kwihuza n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA ku cyiciro cya kabiri. Kwihuza na sisitemu za Leta mu bindi bihugu biboneka ubisabye. Imigaragarire ya porogaramu iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira: Icyarabu, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kinyarwanda. Kugira ngo tuvugane, saba proforma, uteganye inama cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Vugana na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Vugana n'itsinda rya FieldSales: saba proforma, uteganye inama cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp ku bijyanye na porogaramu ya van sales.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tubwire uko abacuruzi bawe bacuruza uyu munsi n'icyo wifuza guhindura. Saba proforma, uteganye inama cyangwa utwandikire kuri WhatsApp, maze umwe mu bagize itsinda ryacu agusubize. Ku bufasha, abakiriya basanzwe bashobora gukoresha izo nzira zimwe. Biradufasha iyo uvuze igihugu cyawe, umubare w'abacuruzi, n'uko bacururiza mu modoka, bafata komande, cyangwa byombi.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Teganya inama kuri murandasi n'itsinda ryacu. Tuzakwereka umunsi w'umucuruzi muri porogaramu n'urubuga rw'igenzura rw'umuyobozi, dukoresheje ingero zegereye ibicuruzwa byawe n'inzira zawe, kandi dusubize ibibazo byawe ku bijyanye no gutangira.
